frontMatter.title: Thursday Club Night at Claremont: Navan vs Loughegar & Navan vs Ardee + Social Badminton
frontMatter.summary: Thursday Club Night is on at Claremont with Grade 4 Mens (Navan vs Loughegar) and Grade 7 Ladies (Navan vs Ardee), followed by two courts of social badminton from 9:30pm.

prev.title: Grade 2 Mixed ‘A’ Team Finish Runners-Up in League Final
prev.summary: Our Grade 2 Mixed ‘A’ team—Alo, Elaine, Anneke and Gerard—finished as runners-up in last night’s league final in Wilkinstown after a strong season, with a standout performance from Elaine Maher serving 21 consecutive points.

next.title: Badminton Weekly Round-Up: Big Wins and Big Finals
next.summary: A strong week for Navan badminton with a 4–0 win for the Grade 7 Ladies and a runners-up finish for Grade 2 Mixed 'A'. Plenty of league and cup action ahead as the season nears its climax.
